laticrete/254-platinum.source: 80 to 95 ft2 per 50 lb bag (7.4 to 8.8 m2 per 22.7 kg) with a 6 x 6 mm notched trowel; 60 to 70 ft2 (5.6 to 6.5 m2) with 6 x 9 mm; 35 to 40 ft2 (3.2 to 3.7 m2) with 12 x 12 mm
laticrete/254-platinum.caveat: Laticrete prints the area a 22.7 kg bag covers, so these are that divided out. The trowel decides it: a 12 x 12 mm notch uses more than twice what a 6 x 6 mm does.
